summary: Iteration 2 full backend+frontend validation for Ruang Personal, fixed 4 roles, and Agenda-merged-into-Pengumuman. 15/15 pytest cases pass; end-to-end Playwright covered sidebar order, 5 personal tabs (notes/reminders/savings/goals/finance CRUD + toggles + balances/progress), Pengumuman agenda category with location + date box, and Ruang Admin (3 tabs, only 4 role options in select).

issues: A11y warning: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (non-blocking Radix warning; add DialogDescription or aria-describedby)

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to all shadcn Dialog usages to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py bootstrap agenda migration runs on every startup and re-inserts announcements each restart if any legacy agenda docs sneak back in; currently safe because db.agendas.delete_many after loop, but the loop runs unconditionally each boot (cheap no-op after first run).
GET /api/kas/{year} still does not exclude APP-role users on the server (already flagged in iter1); UI filters via /members client-side which is fine but inconsistent.
personal PUT accepts arbitrary data keys; consider whitelisting to prevent bloating docs, but per-user scope makes this low risk.
AppContext/api base and cookie-based auth work well; no server-side rate limiting on /personal endpoints (out of scope for MVP).
